verdict.rationale: Docs show full account-provisioning lifecycle: customer creation (personal/business), identity/KYC-KYB verification, account creation with multiple types, disclosures, cards, transfers, and a documented sandbox with API key issuance plus explicit KYC/KYB sandbox test cases for multi-flow testing, indicating sandbox parity before launch. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end walkthrough tying application-to-active-account into one continuous API sequence, and independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox-to-prod parity beyond vendor docs.
